_comment: Regression gate for tests/test_eval_regression.py. This is a RATCHET: raise it when the extractor improves, never lower it to make a red build green. min_recall exists so precision cannot be bought by rejecting everything.

measured.caveat: 36 hand-built seed items, 9 of them real text from the v1 database. The extractor was iterated against this set, so 1.0 is SATURATION, not a precision estimate. It proves the documented v1 bugs are fixed and nothing more. It also cannot score the 2.2.0 title input: the seed titles agree with their descriptions, so no seed item turns on the title alone. Replace with data/labels.jsonl numbers once a real corpus is collected and labelled, and raise min_precision to whatever holds there.
